description: Create a new Doc in a Workspace (ClickUp Docs v3), optionally nested under a Space/Folder/List and with a visibility setting. Returns the created Doc with its id. Add pages afterwards with `create_doc_page`.

create_page.description: If true (default), create an initial empty page in the Doc.

parent.description: Where to place the Doc. Omit to create it at the Workspace level.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

visibility.description: Doc visibility. PUBLIC = visible to the Workspace, PRIVATE = only you.

name: create_doc
